purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. These scores are not measured search volumes and do not prove eligibility or factual truth. Community discussion is discovery-only. Commute/work-injury dental facts must be verified against current Försäkringskassan primary sources, while the Afa commute-traffic boundary must be verified separately against Afa's current primary source.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. Scores are qualitative prioritization, not measured search volume.

natural_language_queries: jag skadade tanden i bilolycka på väg till jobbet vilken försäkring gäller
på väg hem från jobbet påkörd tand skadad afa eller trafikförsäkring
räknas bilolycka till jobbet som arbetsskada och vem betalar tandvården

demand_signal.basis: Public community questions show recurring uncertainty about injuries on the way to or from work and which insurance route applies. This is qualitative discovery only, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: A single commute accident can touch employer incident reporting, Försäkringskassan work-injury dental-cost reimbursement, Afa collective-agreement insurance and traffic insurance. The route boundary differs by system and is easy to collapse incorrectly.

miss_consequence.basis: Wrong routing can delay a dental-cost application, send the user to an inapplicable collective-agreement route, or create a false belief that one insurer's decision settles another system's assessment.

source_fragmentation.basis: Försäkringskassan includes work/commute causation in its dental-cost conditions, while Afa separately excludes commute traffic accidents from its work-injury insurance and points to traffic insurance.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: People naturally say 'påkörd på väg hem', 'bilolycka till jobbet' or 'vem betalar tanden' rather than naming the formal reimbursement and insurance products.

steps_to_action.basis: The person may need to separate where the injury occurred, whether it was a traffic accident, whether dental treatment is necessary because of the injury, cost evidence and dentist connection, then verify separate public, collective-agreement and traffic-insurance routes.

recurrence_signal.basis: Community discussions repeatedly contain conflicting advice about commute injuries, employer/Afa coverage and traffic insurance, which makes this a durable misunderstanding rather than a one-off wording issue.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: v26 added structured work-injury dental truth and regression, but main still lacked a bounded public natural-language route and a permanent guard for Afa's commute-traffic exception before this v27 change.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Convert the existing v26 truth/regression into one privacy-safe same-shell natural-language focus, then add a route-changing commute-traffic question so the product preserves Försäkringskassan's commute dental-cost path while not presenting Afa work-injury insurance as unchanged for a commute traffic accident.
signals.truth_rule: Community and search-like wording are discovery signals only and are not evidence of factual truth or eligibility. Verify current work/commute dental-cost conditions, documents, dentist connection, reference-price and application facts against Försäkringskassan's primary source. Verify the collective-agreement commute-traffic boundary against Afa's primary source. Do not infer a responsible traffic insurer, eligibility, amount or payment date from discovery content or prior AI output.
